task: Determine the actual spectral transition caused by close marked pairs near m=n^(1/3), and seek the log-free subcritical range
success_evidence: Exact proof statements with lower and upper regimes distinguished, independent revision-bound reviews, priority comparisons, and checked finite formal components
scope: Uniform simple fixed-degree regular host, predetermined distinct marks, cubic unweighted model and compatible weighted extensions
limits: One bounded research round, at most three concurrent collaborators, no external correspondence or submissions, no unattended work
checkpoint: After separate attempts are frozen, select the strongest supported theorem and review it
stop: Integrated reviewed theorem or exact unresolved inference after complementary proof attempts and discriminating checks
exposure: Participants have prior-round context and shared filesystem. No access isolation is claimed
